evidence: qwen3-coder: "Function to check if three nodes form a deadlock"
gpt-oss-120b: "for a, b in edges:" followed by common-neighbor search
affordance_in_statement: For any two materials chosen from the configuration, they must have the exact same prohibition status with respect to the remaining third material.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove this collapse: the universal condition forces all three pair-status bits to be equal, and condition 1 therefore forces a triangle. If changing the task definition is acceptable, replace “For any two materials” with an existential condition so non-triangle configurations can qualify, while updating the guarantee and examples consistently.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Tests triples directly, effectively recognizing that the condition is equivalent to requiring all three prohibited pairs.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: For any two materials chosen from the configuration, they must have the exact same prohibition status with respect to the remaining third material.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Iterates through prohibited edges and searches for a common prohibited neighbor, which is exactly triangle detection; sorted edges provide lexicographic order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: At least one pair of materials within the configuration is prohibited ... combined with the universal equal-status condition.

common_affordance: The universal equal-status condition makes every valid nonempty deadlock exactly a prohibited triangle, enabling direct triangle enumeration instead of handling the definition independently.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It prints every triangle it encounters and does not terminate after the lexicographically earliest one, violating the required single-line output.
It enumerates all triples in O(n^3), which is too slow for n up to 2000.

recommended_edit: If the objective is to defeat the surviving triangle-based implementations, change the universal quantifier in condition 2 to an existential one, requiring only one pair to have equal status toward the third. This changes the mathematical task, so the guarantee and examples must be made consistent; no wording-only edit can defeat correct triangle algorithms while preserving the current task.
regression_risk: Changing the quantifier would also invalidate the current examples and could make the already-defeated exhaustive solver return different configurations.
